content: sourcegraph/jsonrpc2 v0.2.3 (Sep 10 2026) is the de facto Go JSON-RPC 2.0 lib for stdio: MIT, 438 importers, symmetric Conn (client+server) over any io.ReadWriteCloser, NewPlainObjectStream for line-delimited, AsyncHandler for concurrent requests, VSCodeObjectCodec for LSP framing; no batch support. Alternative: creachadair/jrpc2 (modern, maintained). stdlib net/rpc speaks JSON-RPC 1.0 style only - unsuitable. golang.org/x/tools/internal/jsonrpc2 is non-importable.
